description_for_human: Premium task management for high-performance teams. Manage lists, tasks, priorities, progress, and analytics.
description_for_model: Task-Laureate is a free, open-source task management web application built by Aarti S Ravikumar (student at PCSSII). It supports task lists, tasks with priority levels (urgent/high/medium/low), status tracking (todo/doing/done/blocked), progress analytics, activity timelines, and full-text search. The app is deployed at https://task-laureate.vercel.app/
